def target_occurrences(note):
    lines = note["content"].splitlines(keepends=True)
    phrase_folded = target_phrase.casefold()
    indexes = [index for index, line in enumerate(lines) if phrase_folded in line.casefold()]
    return lines, indexes

def line_is_done(line):
    phrase_position = line.casefold().find(target_phrase.casefold())
    if phrase_position < 0:
        return False
    prefix = line[:phrase_position]
    prefix_folded = prefix.casefold()
    marked = any(marker in prefix_folded for marker in ("[x]", "[✓]", "[✔]", "☑", "✅", "✔", "✓", "●"))
    struck = prefix.count("~~") % 2 == 1 and "~~" in line[phrase_position + len(target_phrase):]
    return marked or struck

ranked_candidates = []
for search_position, note in enumerate(bucket_list_note_details):
    note_lines, occurrence_indexes = target_occurrences(note)
    if occurrence_indexes:
        normalized_title = " ".join(note["title"].casefold().split())
        title_rank = 0 if normalized_title == "bucket list" else (1 if "bucket list" in normalized_title else 2)
        has_open_occurrence = any(not line_is_done(note_lines[index]) for index in occurrence_indexes)
        ranked_candidates.append((title_rank, 0 if has_open_occurrence else 1, search_position, note))
if not ranked_candidates:
    raise RuntimeError("No searched note contains the requested Bucket List item")
ranked_candidates.sort(key=lambda candidate: candidate[:3])
target_note = ranked_candidates[0][3]
target_note_id = target_note["note_id"]
original_content = target_note["content"]
target_lines, target_line_indexes = target_occurrences(target_note)
open_target_line_indexes = [index for index in target_line_indexes if not line_is_done(target_lines[index])]
target_line_index = open_target_line_indexes[0] if open_target_line_indexes else target_line_indexes[0]
target_was_already_done = line_is_done(target_lines[target_line_index])
proposed_lines = list(target_lines)
if not target_was_already_done:
    original_line = target_lines[target_line_index]
    phrase_position = original_line.casefold().find(target_phrase.casefold())
    line_prefix = original_line[:phrase_position]
    replacement_made = False
    open_to_done_markers = [("[ ]", "[x]"), ("☐", "☑"), ("⬜", "✅"), ("○", "●")]
    for open_marker, default_done_marker in open_to_done_markers:
        marker_position = line_prefix.rfind(open_marker)
        if marker_position >= 0:
            done_marker = default_done_marker
            if open_marker == "[ ]" and "[X]" in original_content and "[x]" not in original_content:
                done_marker = "[X]"
            proposed_lines[target_line_index] = original_line[:marker_position] + done_marker + original_line[marker_position + len(open_marker):]
            replacement_made = True
            break
    if not replacement_made:
        proposed_lines[target_line_index] = original_line[:phrase_position] + "[x] " + original_line[phrase_position:]
proposed_content = "".join(proposed_lines)
mutation_required = proposed_content != original_content
print({
    "selected_note_id": target_note_id,
    "selected_title": target_note["title"],
    "matching_item_occurrences": len(target_line_indexes),
    "already_done": target_was_already_done,
    "content_update_required": mutation_required,
})
